# LoadSaathi

> Online marketplace connecting truck owners and drivers with shippers needing cargo transport across India.

- **Website:** https://loadsaathi.in
- **Contact:** support@loadsaathi.in
- **Address:** Mumbai, India
- **Hours:** 24/7
- **Currency:** INR

## Key Features
- Real-time load matching marketplace
- In-app payments (cashless, dispute-free)
- Smart return route suggestions to reduce empty runs
- Rate & distance checking before booking

## Target Audience
Truck owners, drivers, shippers, small manufacturers, distributors in India (ages 25-55)

## Top-level URLs
- https://loadsaathi.in
